name: iSins Demo
author: lordshadowist
description:
Controls:
Move - WASD
Turn - Mouse Left/Right
Aim Vertical - Mouse Up/Down
Shoot - Mouse Left Button

Start/Restart Buttons can be pressed with the Enter/Return Key

Made with War FX, Simple Healthbars, and Mixamo

Special Thanks to TheKiwiCoder (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjszZMwnOW4fO5VIDU_Wh1Q) for taking the time to help me out
